control.actions: Only original retry then roll; retain every loss and the advancing RNG.

pairArmor.actions: One legal owned-armor equip, then retry/roll. Highest public maxHp*pairWard; ties by estimated damage, maxHp, defense, item ID.

fallback.onlyIf: The armor-only branch does not defeat the current enemy.
fallback.actions: The same chosen armor plus one existing relic maximizing public total pairWard amount; tie by expected damage and item ID. No future-roll selection.

stop: Each branch stops on the first actual chest or its predeclared attempt/roll budget. No equipment reset, RNG reset, or death-counter edit within a branch.
naturalClaim: These are bounded counterfactual recovery branches from an original failure, not successful reruns of the frozen natural policy.
